hmong: Muaj ib tug dais nauv xaum hauv phau ntawv.
english: There is a dinosaur in the book.

hmong: Ib tug ntxhw nyob hauv lub vaj tsiaj.
english: An elephant lives at the zoo.

hmong: Kuv pog muaj ib tug tshis.
Tus tsov ntxhuav pw hauv qhov ntxoov ntxoo.
english: The lion sleeps in the shade.

hmong: Muaj ib tug nab qa saum phab ntsa.
english: There is a lizard on the wall.

hmong: Tus tsiaj yug me nyuam noj mis no loj heev.
Tus liab nce saum tsob ntoo.
Muaj ib tug nas tsaug hauv tsev.
english: There is a mouse in the house.

hmong: Tus ntses ntxhuav loj nyob hauv hiav txwv.
english: The octopus lives in the ocean.

hmong: Tus noog liaj ya thaum hmo ntuj.
Tus aub puv pij no ntxim hlub.
Tus qaib cog sawv thaum sawv ntxov.
english: The rooster wakes up in the morning.

hmong: Tus ntses xab lam ua luam dej ceev heev.
Kuv txiv yuav ib tug ntses pas thus.
Tus ntses pas vas loj heev.
Tus yaj yuam muaj plaub zoo nkauj.
Muaj ib tug ntsuam saum rooj.
english: There is an ant on the table.

hmong: Tus kheb nyob hauv dej.
english: The alligator is in the water.

hmong: Muaj ib tug ntseeb nyob saum ru tsev.
english: There is a wasp on the roof.

hmong: Tus yoov ya ncig saum rooj.
english: The fly circles above the table.

hmong: Tus nas ncuav nce saum tsob ntoo.
Muaj ib tug nas tsuag hauv tsev.
english: There is a rat in the house.

hmong: Tus cua nab nyob hauv av.
english: The earthworm lives in the soil.

hmong: Muaj ib tug nas hauv chav ua mov.
english: There is a mouse in the kitchen.

hmong: Kuv niam hluas nyob tom tsev.
english: My younger sister is at home.

hmong: Kuv viv ncaus nyob ua ke.
Kuv yawg nyiam cog ntoo.
english: My paternal grandfather likes planting trees.

hmong: Kuv yug rau lub yim hlis ntuj.
Cov menyuam pib kawm ntawv lub cuaj hli ntuj.
english: The children start school in September.

hmong: Huab cua txias thaum lub kaum hli ntuj.
english: The weather gets cold in October.

hmong: Peb yuav mus xyuas pog lub kaum ib hli ntuj.
english: We will visit Grandma in November.

hmong: Peb tsev neeg sib sau ua ke lub kaum ob hli ntuj.
english: Our family gathers together in December.

hmong: Kuv pib kawm ntawv thaum Cuaj Hlis.
Huab cua sov dua thaum Peb Hlis.
english: The weather gets warmer in March.

hmong: Hnub tim twg yog koj hnub yug?
Hnub no huab cua zoo heev.
english: The weather is very nice today.

hmong: Kuv kawm lus Hmoob tau ob xyoo.
english: I have studied Hmong for two years.
note: was `ob xyoos` — the age form; the word being taught is `xyoo`, year

hmong: Tus menyuam no khiav sai heev.
Tus aub ntawd rog heev.
Tus miv no yuag heev.
Kuv tus tub nquag kawm ntawv.
Tus menyuam no qib taub heev.
Tus menyuam mos no ntxim hlub heev.
Nws tseem hluas tiamsis paub taub.
note: replaces the batch-1 sentence held for the txiv / tus txiv mix-up

hmong: Tus tub no paub cai heev.
Koj yuav tuaj, nawb?
Koj twb noj mov lawm yom?
Koj tos kuv os.
Koj noj mov lov?
Koj niam ne?
note: was `Koj tus niam ne?` — with a classifier `tus niam` points to a wife, as `tus txiv` does to a husband
